## Install in 1 minute

1. Download **`qa-sessionlab.zip`** below (Assets) and unzip it.
2. Open `chrome://extensions` (Edge: `edge://extensions`) and switch on **Developer mode**.
3. Click **Load unpacked** and select the unzipped folder.
4. Pin the extension (🧩 icon) — a welcome page opens with a one-click setup.

Updating: unzip the new version over the same folder, then click ↻ on the extension card.

**Bahasa Indonesia:** unduh `qa-sessionlab.zip`, ekstrak, buka `chrome://extensions`, aktifkan **Developer mode**, klik **Load unpacked**, pilih folder hasil ekstrak.

See the [changelog](https://github.com/adyfk/qa-sessionlab/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for what's in this release.
